match_results AS (
  SELECT 
    ap.*,
    CASE 
      WHEN ap.team_side = 'home' AND ap.home_team_goal > ap.away_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN ap.team_side = 'home' AND ap.home_team_goal < ap.away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
      WHEN ap.team_side = 'away' AND ap.away_team_goal > ap.home_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN ap.team_side = 'away' AND ap.away_team_goal < ap.home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
    END AS result
  FROM all_players ap
  WHERE ap.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND ap.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER AS wins,
         SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER AS losses
  FROM match_results
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, ps.wins, ps.losses
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = ps.player_api_id
ORDER BY ps.losses DESC
LIMIT 5
